title: T-2 closure: every authority decision against the history it is appended onto
note: D-2026-156. Each mutation removes one part of the closure: a refused fold remembered and never resumed past; a decision taken inside the writer lock, against the head, by the capability, egress and secret writers, the execution record, the compensation authorization and the governed read; one answer consuming one undo on replay; and the second reader's restatement of each. Five move a decision out of the lock (TC5, TC23, TC27, TC33) or off the head (TC26), and are killed by tests/test_decided_under_lock.py, which holds a decision open while another writer competes.
